mostWorthwhile.text: Making the insulated frame was the most worthwhile action: raising the mattress and insulating it from the cold paving had a clear physical purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the mattress was predictable and the only offered combination, though it gave the chapter a welcome quiet ending.

surprise.text: The growing lamps shining on an empty floor gave the completed berth a sense of unfinished life beyond it.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; both clearly served the berth, although the offered choices left little room for decisions.

continue.text: I would continue to see the growing room put to use; the empty floor makes that prospect more interesting than the brief berth-building sequence itself.
